result.summary: The main visual issue identified is the presence of a 'placeholder' or 'broken' image/card at the bottom of the screen, which lacks text, a title, or action elements compared to all other restaurant cards.

issues.description: The bottom-most card on the screen is empty, displaying only a pizza graphic and a '-0%' badge, with no store name, ratings, delivery time, or description.
issues.suggestion: Populate the card with relevant restaurant information or hide the element if no data is available to display.

issues.description: The '-0%' badge on the bottom card appears redundant and potentially confusing as it conveys no meaningful value to the user.
issues.suggestion: Remove the '-0%' badge or replace it with a valid discount or offer value if applicable.
